entries.b31b1beac2cb8ded: Toward realizing its mission, "Tanoshii ne! wo, sekai-juu no nichijo e" (Fun, right? To everyday life around the world), the company aims to pursue mobile game development that is "easy for anyone to play and deep to enjoy," and focuses on planning, development and operation targeting the domestic and global markets. It states that it will maintain revenue from existing titles through stable medium- to long-term operation, and will promote the expansion of business opportunities for new titles through collaboration with a diverse range of partners. It also aims to become a company that can be entrusted with "THE JAPAN IP," and is working on low-cost, short-term, high-quality development and operation by building its proprietary development platform "SEED."
